notes.title: 10 New Levels Released!
notes.content:
Update 1.1.0 is here!

This new update includes:
New Level Pack: Featuring 10 new levels. Unlock it by getting knocked over 3 times in a row without standing up.

New Unlockable Outfit: A new outfit which can be unlocked by playing a match with all modifiers enabled (all modifiers need to be unlocked for this to be possible).

New Feature: We found it difficult to keep track of who is who sometimes, so we added the ability to see the names of players above their characters at any time by holding shift on keyboard, or Y or triangle on controller.

New Item Spawner: An item spawner that works like a dispenser has been added to some of the new levels.

Better Widescreen support: Fixed a bug where you used to be able to see the edges of the water when playing on an ultrawide monitor. 

Bug Fixes: Fixed a bug where decals used to be floating in the air when a player had left the tutorial level, along with some other minor bugs.

notes.title: The Modification Update
notes.content:
Hello there,

For the fourth demo version for Out of Hand Deluxe we are adding 7 modification options:

 Movement speed
 Arm length
 Slippery socks
 Random items in spawners
 Banana mode
 Ammo capacity
 Insane Recoil


You can now try them out on 10 different levels instead of 5. One game is also 10 rounds instead of 5. Some bugfixes and quality of life improvements have been added as well:

 Shows keybinds for easy mode and interaction mode in the tutorial
 Improved table UI
 Added modifications section in the table UI
 Added VIP section in the menu for those invited by the developers
 Minor bugfixes


Bye

notes.title: Localization Update
notes.content:
Hello,

For the third demo version for Out of Hand Deluxe we are focusing on localization. 5 new languages are now supported: Swedish, Spanish, Portuguese, and Simplified & Traditional Chinese. 

We've also done a few smaller bugfixes and some updates:

Changed font to enable support for all languages
5 different maps to play on
Invincibility for half a second when dodging
Sound effects for steps, dodge, item pick up and some ambient
Trail effect when dodging
More accurate outfit names


That's about it

notes.title: The Outfit Update
notes.content:
Hello,

This is the second demo version for Out of Hand Deluxe. This version includes all things available in the first one plus:

8 updated outfits (we gave them clothes, skintones and genders)
5 new outfits unlockable with achievements
5 different maps to play on
A new island menu for all playable outfits and how to unlock them
Added a scoreboard that shows up every third round
Made the characters do a flip when dodging
Proper support for 8 players locally
Upgraded the engine to Unity 6
Removed "Made in Unity" logo
Added more graphics settings
Added pitch variations to most sound effects


Goodbye
